name: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt
source: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt (S.A.E), Auditors report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, translation of statements originally issued in Arabic), EGP thousand, stored absolute
source_note: Read from the audited FY2025 statement of cash flows, EGP thousand stored absolute. Operating plus Investing plus Financing reproduces the printed net change in cash exactly in both years: 20,228,290 - 17,771,664 - 2,256,373 = 200,253 (FY2025) and 14,448,675 + 4,744,544 - 1,614,560 = 17,578,659 (FY2024). Capital Expenditure is the printed payments for fixed assets and fixtures of branches plus payments for intangible assets, stored negative as this dataset stores capex; Free Cash Flow adds it to operating cash flow.

rows.label: Capital Expenditure
